tool_schemas.name: naver_directions
tool_schemas.description: Calculates a route from `start` to `goal` (and optional `waypoints`) by calling Naver Directions, then returns the upstream response while recording request/response metadata for auditing and billing. This endpoint is not paged and returns a single directions result per request; if `idempotency_key` is provided, repeated requests with the same key and equivalent inputs return the originally stored result instead of re-calling upstream. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT when required fields are missing or coordinates are not in the expected `lng,lat` form, UNAUTHENTICATED when `api_key` is missing/invalid, PERMISSION_DENIED when the key is not allowed to use directions, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED when rate limits or quotas are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the Naver API call fails or returns an error.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply quotas/rate limits.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key to deduplicate identical direction requests.

waypoints.description: Optional intermediate points formatted per Naver directions API (e.g., 'lng,lat|lng,lat').

option.description: Routing option passed through to Naver directions API.

coord_type.description: Coordinate system for input coordinates passed through to Naver directions API.

lang.description: Language code passed through to Naver directions API.

cartype.description: Vehicle type code passed through to Naver directions API.

fueltype.description: Fuel type code passed through to Naver directions API.

mileage.description: Vehicle mileage passed through to Naver directions API.

tollgate.description: Toll gate option flag passed through to Naver directions API.

tool_schemas.name: naver_geocode
tool_schemas.description: Geocodes a free-form `query` via Naver Geocoding and returns the upstream results while storing request/response metadata for auditing and billing. Results follow Naver’s pagination using `page` and `count` (when provided), returning the corresponding slice of matches and any upstream paging fields. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT when `query` is empty or pagination parameters are out of range, UNAUTHENTICATED when `api_key` is missing/invalid, PERMISSION_DENIED when the key is not allowed to use geocoding, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED when rate limits or quotas are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the Naver API call fails or returns an error.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply quotas/rate limits.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key to deduplicate identical geocode requests.

query.description: Free-form address or place query to geocode.

coord_type.description: Coordinate system for returned coordinates passed through to Naver geocode API.

page.description: Result page number passed through to Naver geocode API.

count.description: Number of results per page passed through to Naver geocode API.

tool_schemas.name: naver_reverse_geocode
tool_schemas.description: Reverse-geocodes `coords` (typically `lng,lat`) using Naver Reverse Geocoding and returns the upstream response while recording request/response metadata for auditing and billing. This endpoint is not paged and returns a single reverse-geocode response for the supplied coordinate, with result ordering controlled by `orders` when provided. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT when `coords` is missing or not in the expected format, UNAUTHENTICATED when `api_key` is missing/invalid, PERMISSION_DENIED when the key is not allowed to use reverse geocoding, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED when rate limits or quotas are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the Naver API call fails or returns an error.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply quotas/rate limits.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key to deduplicate identical reverse-geocode requests.

output.description: Output format passed through to Naver reverse geocode API.

orders.description: Comma-separated order(s) of reverse-geocode result types passed through to Naver API.

coord_type.description: Coordinate system for the input coords passed through to Naver reverse geocode API.

tool_schemas.name: naver_static_map
tool_schemas.description: 네이버 Static Map API를 호출해 정적 지도 이미지를 생성하고, 결과를 Base64 data URI로 반환하며 요청/응답 메타데이터를 감사·과금·디버깅 목적으로 저장합니다. 이 엔드포인트는 페이징이 없고 단일 이미지를 반환하며, `idempotency_key`가 제공되면 동일 키와 동일 입력에 대해 기존에 저장된 이미지 결과를 재사용할 수 있습니다. 필수/형식 오류(예: 잘못된 `center` 좌표, 잘못된 크기/레벨 값)는 INVALID_ARGUMENT, `api_key` 누락/무효는 UNAUTHENTICATED, Static Map 권한이 없으면 PERMISSION_DENIED, 쿼터/레이트리밋 초과는 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, 네이버 업스트림 호출 실패/오류 응답은 UPSTREAM_ERROR를 반환합니다.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply quotas/rate limits.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key to deduplicate identical static map requests.

level.description: Zoom level passed through to Naver static map API.

w.description: Image width in pixels passed through to Naver static map API.

h.description: Image height in pixels passed through to Naver static map API.

scale.description: Image scale factor passed through to Naver static map API.

format.description: Image format passed through to Naver static map API.

maptype.description: Map type passed through to Naver static map API.

markers.description: Marker specification string passed through to Naver static map API.

path.description: Path/polyline specification string passed through to Naver static map API.

tool_schemas.name: naver_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns information about the calling client identity resolved from `api_key`, including the API key record, allowed endpoints/scopes, current lifecycle status, and near-real-time quota/rate-limit usage snapshot. Refuses UNAUTHENTICATED when `api_key` is missing/invalid and PERMISSION_DENIED when the key is not permitted to access this endpoint.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply quotas/rate limits.

tool_schemas.name: api_keys_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists API keys visible to the authenticated caller, with optional filtering by owner and status. Returns a paginated list ordered by most recently created first. Refuses UNAUTHENTICATED when `api_key` is missing/invalid and PERMISSION_DENIED when the caller is not allowed to enumerate keys.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply quotas/rate limits.

allowed_endpoint.description: Filter keys that allow a specific tool/endpoint.

page_size.description: Maximum number of keys to return.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: api_keys_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API key for the specified owner and returns the created key metadata plus the one-time `api_key` secret value. Newly created keys start in `active` status unless explicitly created as `suspended`. Refuses UNAUTHENTICATED when caller key is missing/invalid and PERMISSION_DENIED when the caller cannot create keys for the requested owner.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply quotas/rate limits.

owner_type.description: Owner type for the new key.

owner_id.description: Owner id for the new key.

status.description: Initial lifecycle status for the key (cannot create as revoked).

quota_daily_requests.description: Daily request quota enforced for this key.

quota_monthly_requests.description: Monthly request quota enforced for this key.

rate_limit_rps.description: Sustained requests-per-second limit for this key.

rate_limit_burst.description: Burst capacity for short spikes above `rate_limit_rps`.

allowed_endpoints.description: List of tools this key is permitted to call.

tool_schemas.name: api_keys_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable properties of an existing API key (name, limits, allowed endpoints, and lifecycle transitions). Supports lifecycle changes via `status` following allowed transitions: active↔suspended and active/suspended→revoked. Refuses NOT_FOUND when the key id does not exist, PERMISSION_DENIED when the caller cannot manage the key, and FAILED_PRECONDITION when an invalid lifecycle transition is requested.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply quotas/rate limits.

id.description: Primary id of the api_keys record to update.

status.description: New lifecycle status (must be a valid transition).

quota_daily_requests.description: Daily request quota enforced for this key.

quota_monthly_requests.description: Monthly request quota enforced for this key.

rate_limit_rps.description: Sustained requests-per-second limit for this key.

rate_limit_burst.description: Burst capacity for short spikes above `rate_limit_rps`.

allowed_endpoints.description: List of tools this key is permitted to call.

tool_schemas.name: naver_credentials_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists configured upstream Naver credential sets available to the service, optionally filtered by provider and lifecycle status. Returns a paginated list excluding sensitive secret material. Refuses UNAUTHENTICATED when `api_key` is missing/invalid and PERMISSION_DENIED when the caller is not entitled to view credential configuration.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply quotas/rate limits.

page_size.description: Maximum number of credentials to return.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: map_requests_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded map request metadata for auditing/debugging, with filters for tool, status, api key, and time range. Returns paginated results and does not include response payloads. Refuses UNAUTHENTICATED when `api_key` is missing/invalid and PERMISSION_DENIED when the caller is not allowed to view the requested records.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply quotas/rate limits.

api_key_id.description: Filter by the internal api_keys.id that originated the request.

created_at_gte.description: Filter for requests created at or after this time (RFC 3339 timestamp).

created_at_lt.description: Filter for requests created before this time (RFC 3339 timestamp).

page_size.description: Maximum number of requests to return.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.
